description.en: Ends an NPC's talk reaction started with CMND_TALK_START: its look-at state is switched off (the same as CMND_RESET_LOOK_AT).

null once done; false if the NPC is not found.
null if the script system is not ready or no argument is given.

examples.case: End of the NPC talk script (real usage, from ev43010000.nut)
